facts.fact: 买牛仔裤连逛三店试到第八条全失败，Gemma 崩溃扬言「剁腿再不穿牛仔裤」。
facts.anchor: We’re at the third shop for the day, and I think Gemma just got herself into pair number eight.

facts.fact: Gemma 自曝情报网：咖啡馆那场「朋友式」见面她全程围观——她在校区这头、最爱的咖啡座。
facts.anchor: You were on my side on campus. At my favourite coffee spot.

facts.fact: Eden 想着 Oliver 的唇分神，玻璃载片切伤手指；Edward 贴创可贴安慰「不是你的错」。
facts.anchor: It wasn’t your fault, Eden. These things happen all the time.

facts.fact: 与父母每周通话，Oliver 相关只报「全家适宜、G 级」的部分。
Mum 建议邀请 Oliver 来农场——「慢慢来，看看进展」，Eden 嘴上回「Absolutely not」。
facts.anchor: Just gently introduce it, okay? See where it goes.

facts.fact: Easter show：妈妈是老师、全家负责艺术展。⚠️ 原书与 ch09「Mum works at the local primary school」矛盾（照录，不擅自统一）。
facts.anchor: As Mum is a teacher at the local high school, my family is responsible for the art exhibition.

facts.fact: Oliver 短信取消辅导课——「I must have scared him off」的导火索。
facts.anchor: Sorry Eden. Can’t make it today.

facts.fact: 打字气泡弹了又消，Eden 等不到下文，把锅扣给自己：我总是用力过猛。
facts.anchor: I must have scared him off. I’m always too much.

facts.fact: 中段假期目标：去农场重置自己、把 Oliver 逐出系统——离 PhD 梦太近，不敢赌。
facts.anchor: So close to the PhD program of my dreams.
